units.text: INT. CURLING RINK - 5 A.M.
A long sheet of pebbled ice under cold blue light.
The rafters are hung with faded club banners.
Frost on the glass.
The Zamboni sits idle at the far end like a sleeping animal.
Four women stand at the hog line in padded jackets, brooms upright.
Breath rises from them in synchronized clouds.
GRETCHEN VANDERMEER, 50s, the skip, holds the house in her gaze as if it might move if she looked away.
BERNADETTE "BERNIE" OKAFOR, 40s, the lead, flexes a wrist wrapped in tape.
LINNEA SOLBERG, 30s, third, adjusts a glove for the tenth time.
And at the back, 19-year-old XIMENA TREVINO, the new second, holds her broom as if it might fire.
We are down by one. Last end. Hammer is theirs.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: They always have the hammer.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: They always have the luck.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: Luck is a story we tell after.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: Should I sweep hard or light?
units.name: XIMENA

units.text: Hard until I say light. Light until I say hard.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: That's the same thing.
units.name: XIMENA

units.text: Then you understand perfectly.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: She will, in a year.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: In a year she will be skipping.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: I don't want to skip.
units.name: XIMENA

units.text: No one wants to skip. We want the rock to go where we want it. The skip is the one who stands there when it doesn't.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: That's the most poetic thing she's said all season.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: It was a little bit poetic.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: It was a rule. Eyes on the broom.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: Okay. Eyes on the broom.
units.name: XIMENA

units.text: Bernie, first stone. Draw to the four-foot. Light touch.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: Light as a prayer.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: Do not say "prayer."
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: Light as an apology.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: Better.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: Bernie settles into the hack.
The ice hisses under her slider as she pushes out, long and low.
She releases the stone, and it glides away with a low whisper, the handle turning slowly.
Sweep!
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: Linnea and Ximena drop and sweep, brooms flicking in perfect alternating rhythm.
Their breath comes in hard bursts.
The stone drifts, curls, slows.
Hold. Hold. Off.
units.name: GRETCHEN

units.text: They lift their brooms.
The stone slides to a stop, dead center of the house.
A tiny sound, like a coin settling on a table.
Nobody cheers.
They only look at it, steaming faintly on the ice.
